description: Rung 8 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Live React UserLevelTeachingMode control at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/UserLevelTeachingMode.tsx. Renders <select> with all 8 user levels (beginner_no_experience, learner, vibe_coder, junior_developer, professional_developer, maintainer, security_conscious_operator, power_user). The four invariants — proofStatusVisible, authorityGatesActive, teachingWindowExplainsBlockedReason, trainingStaysFalse — are CONSTANTS (const x = true) not dependent on the chosen level. Tests refuse any per-level authority override pattern (if (level === 'power_user') &&, loosenGates, disableGate, bypassProof). Captions enforced: 'Beginner mode does NOT hide proof', 'Professional / power mode does NOT bypass proof', 'User level changes EXPLANATION DETAIL only — never authority'. Level changes are state-only.
